title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-distillation in agentic reinforcement learning has produced a growing number of methods. However, existing evaluations often reuse published baseline scores under differing experimental conditions, provide few direct comparisons among contemporaneous methods, and give limited attention to training stability and computational cost. These limitations obscure the source of reported gains and the practical strengths and weaknesses of competing methods. Costly agent training further motivates a common basis for comparison. To address these gaps, we compare ten representative methods against GRPO on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop across three model sizes. Our study comprises 132 training runs totaling 12,124.4 recorded H800 GPU-hours, with repeated evaluations over eight rollout seeds for the pretrained backbones and all eleven trained methods. translated_title: 更多方法，就能带来更好的智能体吗？对智能体强化学习中自蒸馏方法的现实检验
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习中的自蒸馏已催生出越来越多的方法。然而，现有评估往往在不同实验条件下复用已发表的基线分数，同期提出的各方法之间鲜有直接比较，且对训练稳定性和计算成本的关注有限。这些局限掩盖了所报告性能提升的真正来源，也掩盖了各竞争方法在实际中的优缺点。高昂的智能体训练成本进一步凸显了建立统一比较基准的必要性。为弥补这些空白，我们在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Search-QA 和 WebShop 四个基准上，针对三种不同模型规模，将十种代表性方法与 GRPO 进行了对比。本研究共包含 132 次训练运行，累计记录 12,124.4 个 H800 GPU 小时，并对预训练骨干模型及全部十一种训练后的方法在八个 rollout 种子上进行了重复评估。除最终任务性能外，我们还考察了训练进度、稳定性以及测量……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文通过 132 次训练运行（累计超过 1.2 万 H800 GPU 小时），在四个智能体基准和三种模型规模上系统性地将十种自蒸馏方法与 GRPO 直接对比，以厘清性能提升的真实来源，并揭示各方法在性能、训练稳定性与计算成本上的实际优劣。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a large-scale controlled comparison—132 training runs totaling over 12,000 H800 GPU-hours—of ten self-distillation methods against GRPO across four agentic benchmarks and three model sizes, to uncover the true sources of reported gains and each method's practical strengths, weaknesses, stability, and cost.
